name: design-ticket-gets-frontend
description: A design-only request becomes a design ticket that names a new frontend ticket, which waits on it and holds a No design yet line.
prompt: /plan-work plan Our designer will make mock-ups for a new Export dialog on the Orders page of the `web` repo. No code yet, and no frontend ticket exists for it. No tracker tool in this session: show the draft and stop. Do not run any tool except the bundled lint.

assertions.description: the frontend ticket waits for the design
